title: THE GAMBLER OFFER SHOWS ITS ITEM
why: Seen on the 4K gambler screenshot of 2026-10-08: the item on the Limited Time Offer card was a 34 pixel picture beside four lines of text, a speck at the edge of the card. It is now 72 pixels on a soft dark tile, about the height of the lines beside it.
now: The gambler shows the item on offer big enough to see.
